verdict.rationale: The `npx skills add owner/repo` one-liner installs skills directly into agent directories (or via symlink) so they are active for the next session, targeting specific agents like claude-code/codex, with clear documented flags and behavior. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that a freshly installed skill is picked up automatically in the next agent session (only vendor docs/README describe this), and community comments note some confusion/lack of clarity around versioning and update mechanics.
